title: Lab - Deployments
description: Create a Deployment, change its image and read its rollout history.
scenario: Create a Deployment, change its image and read its rollout history. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Create a Deployment
tasks.instructions: Create a Deployment named api with 3 replicas of nginx:1.25.

tasks.title: Task 2 - Roll out a new image
tasks.instructions: Change the image to nginx:1.26 and watch the rollout.
tasks.solution:
kubectl set image deployment/api nginx=nginx:1.26
kubectl rollout status deployment/api

tasks.title: Task 3 - Roll back
tasks.instructions: Roll back to the previous revision.
